The letter {{AurB|f}} was the sixth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "forn" and corresponded to the letter /F/ in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
